name: Jerry R. Means
residence: Gillette, Campbell County (in a 2024 County 17 questionnaire he wrote that he is a Wyoming native, born in Buffalo, and a resident of Gillette for about 60 years)
occupation: Campbell County commissioner; retired co-owner of KG Construction and Magna Energy Services (2024 County 17 candidate questionnaire)
prior_offices: Campbell County commissioner (elected November 2024). He wrote in 2024 that he was then serving on the Campbell County Land Board.
background: Jerry Means is a Campbell County commissioner, elected in November 2024. In a County 17 primary questionnaire he wrote that he is a Wyoming native, born in Buffalo, a longtime Gillette resident, and a retired co-owner of KG Construction and Magna Energy Services, where he helped design and build projects for coal, oil, and gas companies and was involved in budgeting for those companies, and that he was serving on the Campbell County Land Board.
